title: Keep exact colors on your board
summary: Add named color cards, copy their HEX values, and arrange a palette beside your references.
benefit: Keep a chosen color and its purpose close to the images, notes and layouts that use it.
outcome: A Forest color card shows #2F5D50 and the caption Primary packaging, ready to copy, arrange or export.

sections.title: Keep a color and its purpose together
paragraphs: A color card keeps a chosen color and its HEX value together. Give it a name and an optional caption so your palette explains both the color and what it is for.
For example, make a Forest card with the value #2F5D50 and the caption Primary packaging. Changing the app's light or dark appearance leaves the chosen color unchanged.

flow.entry: Open an editable board where you want to collect a palette.

steps.action: Choose Color. On a phone, open Add and choose Color.
steps.result: A new color card appears and the Edit color dialog opens.
The preview shows the chosen green.

steps.action: Enter Forest in Name and Primary packaging in Caption, then choose Done.
steps.result: The card shows the name, exact HEX value and caption, and you return to the board.

steps.action: Drag the color area beside an image or another reference.
steps.result: The card moves without changing its value. You can also resize it or move it into a column with other cards.
Copied! confirms that the displayed value is on your clipboard. The copied value uses the full uppercase HEX form, such as #2F5D50.

steps.action: Select the card and choose Duplicate.
steps.result: A separate card appears. Editing its name, caption or color leaves the original alone.

steps.action: Open More board actions, choose Export, and export the board or selected cards as a PNG.
steps.result: The image includes the swatch, name, HEX value and caption. Editing and copy controls are omitted.

flow.completion: Changes save as you type. Reopening the board restores the chosen color and any unfinished HEX draft. Offline edits stay on your device and sync when the connection returns; check Save status if saving needs attention.
flow.correction: Choose Edit on the card, or select it and press Enter, to change it again. Done or Escape closes the dialog and keeps the changes. Use Undo from the board to restore the previous edit or remove a duplicate. Undoing a newly created card removes that card; Redo brings it back.

sections.title: Resume an unfinished HEX entry
paragraphs: A partial or invalid HEX entry stays saved as a draft. The hint shows which valid color is still being displayed. Reopen Edit to continue the draft without starting over.
Copy HEX continues to copy the displayed valid value while a draft is unfinished.
You can enter six HEX digits with or without the #. Three-digit HEX values expand to six digits.

sections.title: Find a color again
paragraphs: Open Fetch and search for the color's name, HEX value or caption. Choose a matching result to return to the card's board.

sections.title: Access and available tools
paragraphs: People with view-only access can see color cards and copy their HEX values. Changing a card requires permission to edit the board.
Color cards accept HEX values. Automatic palette extraction and an eyedropper are not included.
